title: Real Audio Analysis Baseline
subagentExecutionRules: Before executing any task, read this kiro.json, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, and all requiredSteeringContext files.
Keep edits within the task's declared ownership unless the task explicitly permits broader changes.
Do not add desktop UI, playback scheduling, DJ strategy generation, mobile UI, SQLite, stem separation, or streaming-service functionality in this spec.
Use generated synthetic audio fixtures and test doubles; do not add real music files.
Keep WSL/Linux analysis dependency assumptions out of native C++ app, playback, DJ, and repository modules.
Treat Python/WSL as a POC/reference analyzer, not the final offline mobile runtime.
Use strong Python/MIR libraries aggressively for the POC when they improve analysis quality.
Record library/backend parameters, quality results, licenses, platform constraints, and future native-portability notes for each selected feature family.
Keep analysis dependencies behind explicit optional extras, smoke tests, and structured errors.
Keep confidence values honest; weak analysis must produce warnings and safe fallbacks, not fake high-confidence outputs.
After each task, update tasks.md checkboxes only for work that was completed and verified.
